Task: Explain why the sky appears blue, in three sentences.

steps.action:
The sky appears blue due to a phenomenon called Rayleigh scattering, in which sunlight interacts with gas molecules in Earth's atmosphere. Because blue light has a shorter wavelength than other colors in the visible spectrum, it is scattered much more strongly in all directions across the sky. When you look up, your eyes receive this scattered blue light from every part of the sky, making it appear blue.
